{{Otheruses|panther}}
{{Quote|Well, this is not what I expected&hellip; you're not a ''danger'' at all. You are just a mouse. A ''weak'', scared little ''mouse''. But that's okay, because I&hellip; I am a panther. A mean hungry panther.|[[Red Rishyk]], to [[Deena Shan]]|<ref name="Rebellion 12">[[Rebellion 12|''Rebellion'' 12]]</ref>}}
'''Panthers''' were [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] [[Feline/Legends|feline]] predators that were known to hunt smaller prey that were not a danger to them, such as [[Mouse/Legends|mice]]. When the fancy struck them, panthers played with their prey prior to [[Death/Legends|killing]] and eventually eating it. Known subspecies included the [[Corellian sand panther/Legends|Corellian sand panther]] and the [[plains panther]]. When [[Red Rishyk]], [[Bannistar Station]]'s head of security, discovered and disarmed [[Deena Shan]] during the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Attack on Bannistar Station|attack]] on the station, he metaphorically compared himself to a panther and her a mouse prior to his abortive attempt to kill her.

==Behind the scenes==
Rishyk's comparison to himself as a predator and Shan as his prey, in addition to his statement that he wanted to "play a little" before killing her led a number of readers to believe that he intended to assault her.<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=threads/27836991|board=Literature|thread=Rebellion #12: Small Victories, part 2 (of 4)}}</ref><ref name="DHMB">{{DHBoards|subdomain=www|url=Help/Boards/viewtopic.php?t=13139|thread=REBELLION #12 -- We blew up our own ship. Now what?|nobackup=1}}</ref> Writer [[Jeremy Barlow]] and editor [[Randy Stradley]] stated the dialogue was intended to convey that Rishyk was instead planning to kill Shan in a slow and torturous manner.<ref name="DHMBBarlow">{{DHBoards|subdomain=www|url=Help/Boards/viewtopic.php?p=190839#190839|thread=REBELLION #12 -- We blew up our own ship. Now what?|user=Jeremy Barlow|date=2008-03-13|time=3:23 pm|nobackup=1}}</ref> Stradley in particular, responded to the controversy with the inquiry, "What kind of cats do you guys have where you live?"<ref name="DHMBStradley">{{DHBoards|subdomain=www|url=Help/Boards/viewtopic.php?p=190873#190873|thread=REBELLION #12 -- We blew up our own ship. Now what?|user=Randy Stradley|date=2008-03-13|time=6:53 pm|nobackup=1}}</ref>
